lines.text: Thanks again for the ticket.\nThis ship is huge—and it’s full of Trainers!
BLUE: Bonjour! If it isn’t\n[VAR TRNAME(0000)] and [VAR TRNAME(0001)]!\r\nDidn’t think I’d be seeing the two of you here!

BLUE: Not hardly.\c
I got invited to the exclusive party for Trainers,
but I’m pretty much done with this scene.\c
I got plenty of party favors, too.
Here... I can even share one with you.
You got a [VAR COLOR(0006)]Shalour Sable[VAR COLOR(0000)] from Blue!
More importantly, though...\nyou wanna know what I overheard at the party?\c\nYou guys know about Team Rocket, right?
BLUE: Yup. There are all kinds of rumors going\naround about the things they get up to.
BLUE: Seriously?\nYou must be fearless or something, kid.

Anyway, the point is this:
Team Rocket is a dangerous group, and they’re
trying to use Pokémon to make themselves rich.\c
I might do some digging into what it is they’re
really after...\c
And you two’d better stay out of their path!
[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: Team Rocket, huh...\c\n[VAR TRNAME(0000)], if you get tangled up with\nthose jerks again, you should call me!

[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: Blue’s real strong.\c
I heard he beat the Pokémon League’s Elite Four
years ago.\c
And I heard he’s got a rival who even managed
to beat him, too!\c
How strong would someone have to be to beat
Blue in battle? I can’t even imagine it!
